35x45mm, 29-34mm crown-to-chin, cream/light-grey background, discouraged glasses, and (via the linked digital-photos page) 600x750px minimum and 50KB-10MB file size, plus the under-1 infant exception (eyes may be closed, hand support allowed but not visible), all match the current entry; only the verified date changed.

changes.quote: 乳幼児など丸顔のため、顔の縦の長さを写真規格の最小である32ミリメートルとしても写真の横幅内に顔全体が収まらない場合には、縦方向が32ミリメートルに満たなくても、耳を含めた顔全体を写真に収めるようにしてください。座れない場合は、無地で淡い色のシーツ等に寝かせて真上から撮影したものでも結構です。
changes.reasoning: The page states that for round-faced infants whose full face (including ears) doesn't fit within the frame at the standard 32mm minimum chin-to-crown height, a height below 32mm is permitted as long as the whole face and ears are shown; and that infants who cannot sit up may be laid on a plain light-coloured sheet and photographed from directly above. These are new, distinct infant-specific rules not previously recorded, so infant was changed from null to an object capturing them (headHeightMM left null since the exception is conditional rather than a fixed alternate range; eyesMayBeClosed/mouthMayBeOpen kept false since the page's general rule against closed eyes and markedly different expressions is not stated to be waived for infants).
